decision: Split one physical origin row into parent and first-leaf facts only under five explicit conditions

decision: Keep completeness guards unchanged

decision: Require a scored continuation before splitting a merged origin
evidence: Existing regression has a formatting-only blank continuation; rowspan alone does not prove a parent-child group

decision: Index parent linkage only from the mapped dimension column
evidence: Two independent reviewers reproduced multi-column vMerge overwriting the row-only origin map

decision: Use DOTALL (?s) flag for CATEGORY_TITLE_PATTERN in DeterministicScoreFactExtractor
evidence: Production cell raw text is '部分\n（30\n分）' with newline and rowspan=1; standard regex '.*' fails on newline causing fallback to extract 30 as leaf weight inflating total to 130
consequence: Accurately identifies category title across newlines and prevents continuation row title weight fallback hijacking category score

decision: Retain title weight fallback for genuine leaf items while blocking parent categories
evidence: Disabling title weight fallback globally broke Project 1381 where score is embedded in leaf dimension titles
consequence: Protects against fix-A-break-B regressions across different table layout archetypes

decision: Deploy release 6fad0758b to production and verify live pipeline execution
evidence: Project 33 parsing failed in prod with WEIGHT_SUM_MISMATCH (130 pts) prior to DOTALL fix; re-extracting with new release produced AUTO_APPROVED with exact 100.0 pts and 13 items

decision: MarkItDownSidecarExtractor timeout non-retryable
evidence: Sidecar read timeout (ResourceAccessException) repeated 3 times caused 180s+ hanging and 499 disconnects; noRetryFor ensures immediate fallback to local extractor
consequence: Eliminates 3x timeout amplification, fails fast into local docx extraction

decision: Configure AuthenticationEntryPoint for 401 response on unauthenticated requests
evidence: Spring Security 6 default Http403ForbiddenEntryPoint returns 403 on missing auth, causing frontend client.js to trap user without refreshing token or redirecting to /login
consequence: Aligns with HTTP 401 semantics and allows frontend interceptor to handle session expiration cleanly

decision: Disable ScoreParseDrawer reparse buttons when scoringOverlayVisible or loading
